assumptions: Mine only the ancestor closure of the checked final row; source references are strictly earlier and formula syntax is a finite tree.
Every reachable primitive row is H1/H2/H3 with no references, or ordered MP; all relevant Formula/witness trees are propositional. No HYP, GEN, theory, equality or other referenced rule appears.

Use increasing root order and the unchanged least-external-predecessor growth; inspect prefixes from size2; structural eligibility is the accepted supported-rule/rootedness/propositional/max4-boundary predicate.
Quota is the first2 distinct full keys per donor, with source-order occurrence preservation and no key contraction; cross-donor merging does not reopen a donor quota.
proof: If the reachable closure contains no MP, every root is an unreferenced axiom and no prefix reaches size2: the policy selects no family.
Otherwise let \(r\) be its least-source-index MP, with ordered predecessors \(a,b<r\). Both predecessors are reachable. Either being MP would contradict minimality of \(r\), so both are axioms.
The predecessor identities are distinct. Reusing one row as both antecedent and implication would require a finite Formula \(F\) satisfying \(F=(F\to C)\), impossible by finite syntax-tree size.

Every earlier reachable root is an axiom and yields no size2 candidate. Growth at \(r\) therefore produces the first eligible prefix \(\{r,\min(a,b)\}\), with one boundary port. Its next step adds the other axiom, giving \(\{r,a,b\}\), with no boundary ports. Both are rooted, supported and within the frozen limits.

The full keys differ because their internal-node lists have lengths2 and3. They are consequently the first two distinct keys for that donor and fill its quota before any later/larger prefix can be selected.
finding: For the stated pure closed propositional proof DAGs, this unchanged policy selects only size2/3 families, or no family. It cannot acquire a larger family or an internally shared DAG: the selected shapes are one axiom plus MP with one boundary, and two distinct axiom leaves plus MP. The two selected families overlap as source subgraphs; overlap between two records is not internal fan-out sharing within one acquired family.
scope_precision: This is a deterministic selection-policy limitation, not an inference-soundness defect or a reason to reject unchanged Source implementation.

The previously reviewed current donor rule censuses contain only H1/H2/H3 and MP. No row graph was inspected or mined for this addendum; the argument handles both existence and absence of a reachable MP.

Eligibility here is structural. If a selected source-instance later exceeds tiny-encoder or resource limits, it refuses/STOPs under the existing gate; it does not authorize silently skipping it to mine later families.

Current work can establish primitive proof -> typed family -> identity-preserving checked instance feasibility. It cannot establish multiscale or internally shared-DAG acquisition, hierarchical reuse, learned utility or GCTS/RL benefit.

The existing DAG-shared declaration/control can establish public instance-service support for an independently supplied shared shape. It must not be labeled coverage that this extraction policy actually acquires such a shape.
effect_on_prior_review: Strengthens the prior EX10 practical-risk statement into this proved conditional restriction. All settled layouts, exact2..8/max4/max2 limits, current Source-only authority, original controls/caps and prior no-execution boundaries remain unchanged.
